paper_title: Bounds on heavy axions with an X-ray free electron laser
notes: Light-shining-through-wall experiment at European XFEL using Laue-case Primakoff conversion in Ge crystals. Table I gives 90% CL limits at 5 detuning angles. The on-Bragg (Delta-theta=0) run gives a broadband bound g < 3.91e-4 GeV^-1 for m_a below ~44 eV (paper states sensitivity down to ~1e-3 eV), encoded as a two-point flat segment. The off-Bragg runs are narrow resonances (width ~1e-3 eV) at m_a = 340, 460, 1100, 2400 eV, encoded as single points each.
